'''Sleeft Docking Bay Maintenance''' was a transport company based in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They controlled several cargo storage units near the Mos Eisley Spaceport. At some point, they attempted to steal a shipment of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts from the [[Notsub Shipping Company]], but the shipment fell into the hands of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Angor Farn]] instead. One of Sleeft's directors was [[Coral Ohah]].<ref name="B" />
